root_idea.summary: A contrasting spot or patch that differs in color from what surrounds it.
root_idea.development: This principle develops into the meanings of leprosy and other marked discolorations, mottled or barren patches, the spotted moon, and shining or glistening appearance; related animal names reflect the same association with a leprous hue.

senses.definition: A person afflicted with leprosy; the leper.
senses.usage_conditions: Used substantively in the Quranic occurrences, in the definite form.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I verb describing a person who becomes afflicted with the disease.
A Form II verbal construction with the head as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For rain to fall upon land before it has been ploughed or tilled.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical Form II construction concerning rain and uncultivated land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to become leprous, including by begetting a leprous child.
To leave no pasture in a land; to depasture it completely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical Form V construction, especially of an animal seeking pasture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small reptile inhabiting a well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A zoological noun distinguished by its vocalization from بُرْصٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gecko or lizard of a leprous hue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A zoological noun identified with the species called وَزَغَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Leprosy; a white discoloration appearing on the skin, or a white change in an animal caused by a bite.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may denote the disease itself or the resulting visible whiteness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A white or distinct barren patch in sandy ground where nothing grows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of portions of sand that differ from the surrounding ground; plural بِرَاصٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place where jinn alight; in the plural, such alighting-places.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or specialized plural use of بِرَاصٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An opening in cloud or mist through which the face of the sky is visible.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical description of a break in cloud or fog.
A descriptive adjective, comparable to بَصِيصٌ and بَرِيقٌ.
A botanical noun said to grow in channels of running water.
A fixed bird name, distinct from the diminutive use of بُرَيْصٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small reptile, smaller than a gecko, whose bite is said not to be cured.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A zoological noun for a particularly harmful small reptile.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gecko or lizard, especially one of the large kinds of gecko.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed generic appellation; the term also occurs in variant grammatical forms.
A figurative designation based on its mottled or spotted appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A serpent whose skin has white patches distinct from its general color.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a marked or mottled serpent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land bare of herbage, especially where grazing has left some places exposed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical adjectival construction describing patchy loss of vegetation.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Diminutive statement without an independent lexical meaning.

cautions: The Quranic surface form is أَبْرَصَ, while the public headword is normalized to the citation form أَبْرَصُ; in these verses it functions substantively as “the leper.”
